name: Check Sky Light
description: Check Sky Light v2.1 is an empirical civilian sky diagnostics and forensic UAP investigation suite. Featuring an executive Less-Ink tactical HUD, it deconflicts live airspace (ADS-B transponders, NOAA sounding balloons, Starlink/NORAD satellite passes, and celestial ephemeris) while running Dual-Lens physics evaluation (Classical Aerospace vs. Metric Decoupling). Includes Tier I–V source vetting (Department of War PURSUE declassifications, AARO, SCU), AI media forensics, smartphone 3D sightline triangulation, and certified PDF/MUFON CMS incident dossiers.
